Landlord Compliance Audit

A complete property-by-property review of your documentation, rent handling, tenant management, and notice practices — with a checklist of what to fix.

Why You Need This Service

If a tenant lodges a complaint with the Rent Control Department, your documentation becomes evidence. Many landlords lose cases not because the law is against them, but because their records are weak, incomplete, or missing.

This audit checks:

  • Do you have signed leases for all tenants?
  • Are rent receipts issued every payment?
  • Is your rent advance handling compliant with Act 220?
  • Are notices served correctly and documented?
  • Is tenant information organized and traceable?
  • Do you have evidence of maintenance and repair requests?
  • Are your communication records organized chronologically?

This is insurance. If you ever need to defend a position in Rent Court, a clean compliance record means you win.

What We Audit

  • Lease Documentation: Are all leases signed, dated, and complete?
  • Rent Receipts: Do you issue receipts? Are they legible and traceable?
  • Rent Advance: Is advance rent handled and documented correctly?
  • Tenant Records: Can you quickly find info on any tenant?
  • Maintenance Handling: Are repair requests tracked and resolved?
  • Notice Procedures: Are notices served correctly with proof?
  • Communication Trail: Can you show chronology of interactions with tenants?
  • Payment Records: Are payments tracked and verifiable?

What You Get

  • Written Audit Report: Property-by-property review with findings
  • Compliance Checklist: What's good, what's missing, what needs fixing
  • Remediation Plan: Step-by-step guidance to get compliant
  • Documentation Templates: Forms and processes to use going forward
  • Risk Assessment: Which gaps pose the most legal risk

When You Need This Service

  • You manage multiple properties and want consistency
  • You've had a rent complaint and want to check your records
  • You're starting to take property management seriously
  • You want to know if you could win a dispute if one arises
  • You're about to apply for a business loan (banks like clean records)

The Payoff

A good audit costs GHS 500–1,000. Losing a rent case because your records are weak costs thousands in lost rent, legal stress, and time. It's one of the best investments you can make.
